Moving around

Left-drag
orbit round the point you're looking at
Right-drag
look around from where you are
W A S D · arrows
fly forward, back, left, right
E · Q
up and down through the galactic plane
Shift

Scroll · + −

Middle-drag · Shift-drag
slide the view

Stars

Click
fly to a star · click again to open it
F
frame the selected star again
Esc
let go of the selected star
T · R
look straight down · back to the whole map
